comment: PBR description for hero_emissive_sign (C-13). The emissive mask is authored SDR; the HDR half of the cell is recorded as blocked on the C-10 format decision rather than faked.
surface: painted sign panel with an illuminated glyph block

hdr.why: the pinned BC7_UNORM_SRGB path clamps above 1.0 and no HDR container is decided (C-10); the authored mask keeps bar and glow detail so an HDR encode would not require re-authoring

ao.why: no baked AO authored for this cell; AO is not synthesised from the albedo

emissive.encoding: SDR luminance mask with bar and glow detail
emissive.hdrRadiance: blocked: see the hdr object; the source is not a clipped flat white plate
